risks.risk: Not actually food-grade / no certification or markings; could be repurposed for non-food chemicals.
risks.proof: Ask for clear close-up photos of any label/stamp on the tank (IBC) showing food-grade/UN/DOT/chemical compatibility and manufacturer details.

risks.risk: Possible leaks or seepage at the valve/tap, bottom outlet, or seams that a single wide photo can’t confirm.
risks.proof: Request a short video showing the tap/valve area and a fill-and-drain or pressure/water test (even a brief leak check).

risks.risk: Lid/seal condition may be incomplete or degraded (gaskets, caps, bung).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the top lid/bung and gasket area from directly above and from the side.

risks.risk: Capacity/size may differ from the comparable (e.g., not exactly 1000L class).
risks.proof: Request a photo of the capacity marking/label on the tank or a tape-measure/verified dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case match to the visible IBC class (assume 1000L class only if confirmed).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the IBC label/stamp (manufacturer, capacity, and any food-grade/chemical compatibility markings).
Close-up photos of the top lid/bung and gasket/seal area.
Close-up photos and a short video of the valve/tap and outlet/bottom area.
A brief leak check: fill with water and show no dripping/seepage (or show a recent test).
Photo showing the tank capacity marking (to confirm it matches the 1000L class comparable).
